headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment tools to provide users with up-to-date security and dependency issues, ensuring that the installed packages are free from known vulnerabilities. Incorporate user feedback mechanisms to continuously improve the accuracy of the audit process.
